response.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
         AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_order
)
SELECT p.orderslink,
       p.avg_rebtotal,
       p.avg_ratio,
       CASE WHEN o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN p.avg_ratio / o.mean_ratio END AS relative_ratio
FROM per_order p
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'Clear the threshold' means strictly greater than 0.0005 (rebrate > 0.0005).
A feerate of 0 yields a NULL ratio (via NULLIF) instead of a division error, and NULL ratios are ignored by AVG.
The overall mean is taken across all orders (groups) with a non-null per-order average ratio, and a zero mean would give a division error is not guarded beyond NULL check.
Fee rows with NULL orderslink form their own group and are included.
